## Publications

```{r pubs}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

source("R/bib_helpers.R")

all  <- bib2df("papers_all.bib", separate_names = FALSE)
kw   <- ifelse(is.na(all$KEYWORDS), "", all$KEYWORDS)
pubs <- all[!grepl("workingpaper", kw, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
pubs <- pubs[order(as.integer(pubs$YEAR), decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE), ]

cat('<div class="papers-other">')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pubs))) cat(render_paper_compact(pubs[i, ]))
cat('</div>')
```
